_comment: Curated, hand-written guidance for how the assistant asks for each templated value. Field NAMES come from templates/ (see frontend/scripts/build-documents.mjs); this file supplies the human half. Everything is optional - a field with no hint falls back to its label.

effectiveDate.ask: What date should the agreement start?

governingLaw.ask: Which state's law should govern the agreement?
governingLaw.caption: The law that applies, e.g. Delaware

chosenCourts.ask: Where should any disputes be heard?
chosenCourts.caption: Where disputes are settled

noticeAddress.ask: Where should formal legal notices be sent?
noticeAddress.caption: An email or postal address

agreement.ask: Which agreement does this one attach to?
agreement.caption: The agreement these terms supplement

dpa.ask: Is there a data processing agreement that goes with this?
dpa.caption: Optional -- leave as none if there isn't one

generalCapAmount.ask: What should the general cap on liability be?
generalCapAmount.caption: The usual limit on what either side can owe

increasedCapAmount.ask: Should some claims have a higher cap than the rest? If so, how much?
increasedCapAmount.caption: A higher limit for the claims listed below

increasedClaims.ask: Which kinds of claim should get that higher cap?

unlimitedClaims.ask: Are there any claims that shouldn't be capped at all?

additionalWarranties.ask: Any promises either side wants to make beyond the standard ones?

customerCoveredClaim.ask: Which claims should the customer cover the provider for?

providerCoveredClaim.ask: Which claims should the provider cover the customer for?

companyCoveredClaim.ask: Which claims should the company cover the partner for?

partnerCoveredClaim.ask: Which claims should the partner cover the company for?

fees.ask: What are the fees, and how are they worked out?

paymentProcess.ask: How and when does payment happen?
paymentProcess.caption: e.g. invoiced monthly, net 30

paymentPeriod.ask: How long does the customer have to pay an invoice?

subscriptionPeriod.ask: How long does each subscription period run?

orderDate.ask: What date is the order placed?

nonRenewalNoticeDate.ask: How much notice is needed to stop it renewing?

securityPolicy.ask: Is there a security policy the provider has to follow?

purpose.ask: What are the two companies sharing information about?
purpose.caption: How Confidential Information may be used

jurisdiction.ask: Where should any disputes be heard?
jurisdiction.caption: e.g. "courts located in New Castle, DE"

mndaTerm.ask: Should the NDA run for a set number of years, or until someone ends it?
mndaTerm.caption: The length of this MNDA
options: Continues until terminated in accordance with the terms of the MNDA.

termOfConfidentiality.ask: How long should the information stay confidential?
termOfConfidentiality.caption: How long Confidential Information is protected
options: {n} year(s) from Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws.

mndaModifications.ask: Any changes to the standard terms? Most agreements have none.
mndaModifications.caption: List any modifications to the MNDA

trainingData.ask: Which of the customer's data, if any, may be used to train models?

trainingPurposes.ask: What may that data be used to train models for?

trainingRestrictions.ask: Any limits on how that training may be done?

improvementRestrictions.ask: Any limits on using the customer's data to improve the service?

baaEffectiveDate.ask: What date should this BAA start?

breachNotificationPeriod.ask: How quickly must a breach be reported?

limitations.ask: Any limits on how the provider may use protected health information?

useLimitations.ask: Any limits on how much the customer may use the service?
useLimitations.caption: e.g. seats, API calls, storage

categoriesOfPersonalData.ask: What kinds of personal data will be processed?

categoriesOfDataSubjects.caption: e.g. the customer's employees and end users

natureAndPurposeOfProcessing.ask: What will the provider do with that data, and why?

durationOfProcessing.ask: How long will the data be processed for?

frequencyOfTransfer.ask: How often is data transferred -- continuously, or now and then?

specialCategoryData.ask: Does any of it count as special category data, like health or biometric data?

specialCategoryDataRestrictionsOrSafegua.ask: What extra safeguards apply to that special category data?

approvedSubprocessors.ask: Which subprocessors is the provider allowed to use?

governingMemberState.ask: Which EU member state's law applies?

providerSecurityContact.ask: Who should be contacted about security issues?

program.ask: What does the design partner programme involve?

term.ask: How long should the partnership run?

fees.ask: Are there any fees, or is this unpaid?

obligations.ask: What is each side agreeing to do?

territory.ask: Which territory does the partnership cover?

brandGuidelines.ask: Are there brand guidelines for using each other's trademarks?

pilotPeriod.ask: How long should the pilot run?

customerObligations.ask: What does the customer need to do for the work to happen?

customerPolicies.ask: Any customer policies the provider's staff have to follow?

sowTerm.ask: How long does the statement of work run?

rejectionPeriod.ask: How long does the customer get to reject a deliverable?

resubmissionPeriod.ask: How long does the provider get to fix and resubmit it?

timeOfAssignment.ask: When does ownership of the deliverables transfer to the customer?

insuranceMinimums.ask: What insurance must the provider carry?

targetUptime.ask: What uptime are you committing to?
targetUptime.caption: e.g. 99.9%

targetResponseTime.ask: How quickly will support requests be acknowledged?

supportChannel.ask: Where should customers send support requests?
supportChannel.caption: e.g. support@example.com

uptimeCredit.ask: What credit does the customer get if uptime is missed?

responseTimeCredit.ask: What credit does the customer get if a response is late?

scheduledDowntime.ask: When is planned maintenance allowed, and how much notice is given?

permittedUses.ask: What is the customer allowed to use the software for?

licenseLimits.ask: Any limits on the licence -- seats, installations, environments?

warrantyPeriod.ask: How long does the warranty last?

deletionProcedure.ask: What must the customer do with the software when the licence ends?

limitations.ai-addendum: An AI Addendum attaches to an existing agreement rather than standing on its own. Name the agreement it supplements and the addendum will reference it.
limitations.professional-services-agreement: One statement of work per agreement. A PSA can carry several in practice; drafting more than one is not supported yet.
limitations.data-processing-agreement: The annexes are filled from your answers. The Standard Contractual Clauses the DPA incorporates are reproduced as written and cannot be configured here.
